source: React + TypeScript SHRAMIK dashboard, Skill Gap Analysis, Forecasts & Early Warnings, and Reports integrated under the same Header and Sidebar
localStyles: shramik-dashboard.css includes the shared design system, Skill Gap Analysis, Forecasts & Early Warnings, and Reports styles
directSkillGapEntry: skill-gap-analysis.html loads the same shell; route initialized from pathname; #dashboard still overrides it
directForecastsEntry: forecasts.html loads the same shell and opens Forecasts & Early Warnings from the pathname
directReportsEntry: reports.html loads the same shell and opens Reports & Intelligence Briefs from the pathname
dataMode: Mock by default, with visible illustrative provenance. Configure config.js to activate REST; errors do not switch to mock.
runtimeDependencies: Google Fonts (Barlow Condensed, IBM Plex Sans)
limitation: Standard Vite production build not run: npm registry DNS unavailable. This is a custom precompiled static bundle and uses CDN React; preferred production build is npm install followed by npm run build.
